fields.name: content_heading

fields.name: search_placeholder
fields.label: Search box placeholder
fields.description: Text over 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_clearAll
fields.label: Clear all button
fields.description: Shown once a filter is ticked; over 15 characters is cut with “…”.

fields.description: E.g. Pune, India (Locations filter); over 20 characters is cut with “…”.

fields.name: meta_tags
fields.label: Other filter values
fields.description: Hidden filter words, comma-separated (e.g. 3-5 years); max 100 characters.
